**name:** Upholstered-style fluted banquette bench with integrated back panel and fixed table

**description:** The item is a built-in corner-style banquette seat: a low plinth base carrying a seat deck with three drawer fronts on the front face, a tall slatted back panel (vertical fluted fins with rectangular cut-outs) running along the full width of the unit, and a separate fixed table top on two cylindrical legs projecting from the side opposite the back panel. The back is a solid panel structure with vertical slats and horizontal cross-members, rising from the seat deck to the top of the back. The table is a freestanding fixed element attached to the bench's side, forming a seating-and-table arrangement.

**materials:**
- Plinth, carcass, seat deck, drawer boxes and back-panel structure: wood-grain veneered board (veneered MDF or veneered chipboard), 17 mm, inferred from wood-grain texture on the rendered views.
- Back slats/fins and drawer fronts: same veneer finish, thickness as above, inferred.
- Plinth base (recessed kick/plinth strip): dark finish, thickness not specified, default 17 mm, default.
- Table top: pale/light-coloured surface (laminate or solid surface), 20 mm thickness, specified by the side elevation dimension "20" on the back-panel depth and the table top detail; the table top thickness is best read as a light laminate board, inferred.
- Table legs: black cylindrical legs, material not specified, inferred as steel tube or solid rod, default.
- Upholstery: none shown; the seat is a wooden deck, not padded.

**assumptions:**
- The seat deck and back are one integrated wooden structure; no upholstery is shown, so the seat is treated as a flat veneered deck.
- The table is fixed to the bench's side (cantilevered or leg-supported), with two legs visible in the elevations.
- The back-panel thickness is 20 mm as dimensioned in the plan and side views; the finished veneered board is assumed to be 17 mm LDSP-equivalent veneered MDF with a 20 mm overall assembly, inferred.
- Material codes and finishes are inferred from the rendered wood grain and colour; no explicit material legend was supplied on this page.

**name:** L-shaped kitchen run with a wall-mounted corner unit, fridge tower and return

**description:** This is an L-shaped kitchen comprising a main base run with a corner section, a linear base run with a built-in sink and a worktop, a tall fridge/pantry tower at the end of the return, and wall units above the main run. Two separate wall-mounted units hang on the wall: a tall corner-adjacent unit with a glazed-looking front and an upper cabinet above the main run. The base run is topped with a worktop incorporating an inset sink and a corner section with a chamfered profile, while the end runs into a tall column unit that is partly open at its lower section. The item is installed between walls and attaches to the wall structure through wall-mounted units and the tall tower.

**materials:**
- Carcasses (base, wall and tall units): LDSP, 17 mm, inferred from ordinary panelled kitchen construction and no other specification.
- Doors and drawer fronts: finished panel, likely laminated or lacquered MDF/LDSP, 18 mm, inferred from the flat recessed-handle style visible in the elevations.
- Worktop: solid-surface or laminated board, 30 mm, default for a finished worktop; a wood-look area on the corner suggests a laminate or timber-effect finish, inferred.
- Visible shelf/back panels and interior fittings: LDSP, 17 mm, default.
- Sink insert: stainless steel or composite, inferred from the inset rectangle on the worktop.

**assumptions:**
- The lower run is supported by the floor via a plinth and the cabinet carcasses; the wall units are fixed to the wall rails, and the tall column is floor-standing and fixed to the wall.
- The chamfered corner on the worktop is a 45° cut on the corner section, based on the plan.
- The wood-grain-looking corner panel is a ready-made veneered or laminate board rather than solid timber.
- Default panel thickness of 17 mm applies to carcasses; default worktop thickness of 30 mm applies.
- The drawer and door fronts are flat, not profiled, and fit within the standard carcass sizes shown.
